# Motion: swap the person in your clip for your reference on LTX 2.3

Regenerates only the person you name in your clip, as the subject of your reference image and your prompt, and keeps the camera, the motion and the rest of the frame. LTX 2.3 22B distilled with the masked reference inpaint LoRA by Alissonerdx renders it in two passes. The video carries your clip's own sound when it has one.

## Inputs

- Your clip, node 1. The first 5 seconds are read at 24 frames a second, or at the clip's own rate when it is lower. The video's long side is 960 px.
- Your reference, node 2: one image of the new subject. BiRefNet places it on white.
- Who to replace, node 3: a short description SAM 3.1 tracks, such as `the person`. It tracks one.
- Your prompt, node 4: the scene with the new subject in it, described in detail. The result depends on it most.
- The seed, node 5.

## How it works

The person is painted magenta, 255 0 255, in blocks of 8 px in the half-size guide and 32 px in the full-size guide. Your reference sits in a 256 px chroma green panel, 0 255 0, beside your frames. LTXVAddGuideMulti gives that guide to the LoRA. Pass 1 renders at half size, and pass 2 refines at full size. LTX returns the whole render as your clip, with no panel and no bands, so the graph scales it to your clip's shape and keeps your framing.

## Models

- [ltx-2.3-22b-distilled_transformer_only_fp8_input_scaled_v3.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Kijai/LTX2.3_comfy), [LTX-2 Community License](https://github.com/Lightricks/LTX-2/blob/main/LICENSE-2).
- [ltx23_inpaint_masked_r2v_rank32_v1_3000steps.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Alissonerdx/LTX-LoRAs), by Alissonerdx, [Apache-2.0](https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0).
- [gemma_3_12B_it_fp8_scaled.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/ltx-2), [Gemma Terms of Use](https://ai.google.dev/gemma/terms), with [ltx-2.3_text_projection_bf16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Kijai/LTX2.3_comfy).
- [LTX23_video_vae_bf16.safetensors and LTX23_audio_vae_bf16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Kijai/LTX2.3_comfy), and [ltx-2.3-spatial-upscaler-x2-1.0.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.3), LTX-2 Community License.
- [sam3.1_multiplex_fp16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/sam3.1), under the SAM License in `sam-license.txt`.
- [birefnet.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/BiRefNet), [MIT](https://huggingface.co/ZhengPeng7/BiRefNet).

Two packs: ComfyUI-KJNodes at `ab72eda7ffad6280422d71ab7d54d3fb87c0ba18`, GPL-3.0, and ComfyUI-BFSNodes at `1e76045b19a99882f1331c9d322a26fac60ae9b8`, GPL-3.0.

Adapted from Alissonerdx's workflow `masked_ref_inpaint_v1`. Part of [Rosesfield](https://github.com/rossaai/rosesfield), MIT.
